design_rationale: The study is described as a randomized, double-blinded, placebo-controlled intervention trial in which students of each sex were randomly allocated to one of three intervention arms.

domain_judgments.rationale: While participants were stated to be randomly assigned stratified by sex, the specific method of sequence generation and allocation concealment were not reported.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The study was designed as a randomized double-blinded, placebo-controlled, longitudinal intervention trial. All subjects at both schools were shown to have IDA at baseline... Students of each sex were assigned randomly to the different intervention arms.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was double-blinded with supervised feeding and very high compliance, and no unintended deviations from the assigned protocol were reported.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The study was designed as a randomized double-blinded, placebo-controlled, longitudinal intervention trial... Field workers distributed and fully supervised the ingestion of the meals mixed with the 3 varieties of fish sauce. Food that was not consumed was re-weighed and recorded.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome data were available for 137 out of 140 enrolled participants (97.9%), representing an extremely low attrition rate that is unlikely to bias the results.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Three female subjects dropped out (= 2.2%); two of them abandoned and one was excluded when hb dropped to 59 g/L. Thus, data on 137 subjects were available for analysis [55 males (40%) and 82 females (60%)]...

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were objective laboratory and anthropometric measurements assessed using standardized automated instruments with quality controls under double-blind conditions.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Whole blood was collected in EDTA vials and hb concentration was analysed within 6 h of blood sampling (CELL-DYN® 3200 automated laboratory analyser; Abbott®; internal quality control material: CELL-DYN® 26, Abbott®). Serum ferritin was measured with a commercial enzyme-linked immunoassay (AXSYM® System, Abbott; quality control material: AXSYM®, Abbott).

domain_judgments.rationale: There is no mention of a pre-registered trial protocol or pre-specified analysis plan, raising some concerns for selective reporting although all hypothesized primary endpoints were reported.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The a priori, main effective hypothesis of the study was that supplementation of iron would lead to significantly different increments in hb and SF concentrations between the FeSO4+citrate group, the NaFe-EDTA group, and the placebo group.

overall_summary: The overall risk of bias is judged as some concerns due to lack of detailed reporting on allocation concealment/randomization sequence generation (Domain 1) and lack of an accessible pre-registered protocol (Domain 5).

design_rationale: The study is a cluster-randomized trial in which nine villages were randomly assigned to receive either NaFeEDTA-fortified soy sauce or nonfortified control soy sauce.

domain_judgments.rationale: Allocation was at the cluster level across only 9 villages, with no specific details provided regarding the sequence generation, allocation concealment, or adjustment for clustering, although baseline characteristics were broadly similar.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Nine villages in the Haizijie Region were randomly assigned to one of two groups. The fortified group was provided with NaFeEDTA-fortified soy sauce and the control group with nonfortified soy sauce. The two groups of villages were evenly distributed on either side of a small road.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was double-blinded using identical nonfortified control soy sauce, with village stores stopping other soy sauce sales, minimizing unintended deviations from the intended intervention.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The subjects in the fortified group were given iron-fortified soy sauce, whereas those in the control group were given nonfortified soy sauce of the same brand and quality. ... The two sauces were reported to taste the same. No other soy sauce was brought into the nine villages.

domain_judgments.rationale: Loss to follow-up over 18 months was low (6% to 14%) and reasons for dropout (e.g., working out of town) were unrelated to health outcomes, making bias from missing data unlikely.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: For example, the dropout rate for hemoglobin assays was 14% in the fortified group as a whole and 6% in the control group during the 18 months of intervention. The main reasons for dropping out were that some subjects were not available at the time of follow-up examinations or were working out of town.

domain_judgments.rationale: Objective laboratory assays (cyanmethemoglobin method, radioimmunoassay) were conducted on blinded samples, preventing detection bias.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Analytical standards and blind samples were used in all laboratory analyses. FFQs were checked by local team leaders before data entry. All data were double entered. Logistic checking and range checking were conducted at the Institute of Nutrition and Food Safety in Beijing.

domain_judgments.rationale: There is no mention of a pre-registered trial protocol or pre-specified statistical analysis plan, raising some concerns for selective reporting.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Data analysis was conducted by analysis of variance (ANOVA) with the Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS).

overall_summary: The overall risk of bias is judged as some concerns due to limited reporting on the random sequence generation/concealment in the cluster allocation of nine villages (Domain 1) and the absence of a pre-registered analysis protocol (Domain 5). Other domains (deviations from intervention, missing data, outcome measurement) showed low risk of bias.

design_rationale: The study allocated 264 families to fortified or control groups using computer-generated random numbers.

domain_judgments.rationale: Sequence generation was computer-generated, allocation was coded and double-blind, and baseline characteristics were comparable between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The 264 families were divided by use of computer-generated random numbers into fortified (135 families) and control (129 families) groups. Both groups were taken from the same area to minimize possible variations in Fe status because of geographical location. The study was conducted as a double-blind procedure, the fortified and unfortified masala being identified by means of a numbered code.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was double-blind, packaging and distribution were monitored with quality checks, and minor deviations did not impact the findings.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The study was conducted as a double-blind procedure, the fortified and unfortified masala being identified by means of a numbered code... Eight of the fortified families and four of the unfortified families were found in single episodes to be using the incorrect form of masala. Exclusion of these families from the final analysis did not alter the results.

domain_judgments.rationale: There was substantial attrition (~31.7% over 2 years), and although reasons and rates were balanced between groups, no imputation or intention-to-treat analysis accounting for missingness was performed.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: After 2 y of fortification, 672 subjects remained in the study. A total of 267 subjects dropped out of the study: 129 moved away from the area, 115 refused to participate further, and 23 died. There were no significant differences in the number or category of dropouts between the fortified and unfortified groups.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were objective laboratory hematological measurements evaluated using standardized, quality-controlled assays with blinded trial design.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Venous blood samples (10 mL clotted and 5 mL with EDTA) were taken annually from each subject for the determination of the percentage saturation of transferrin, serum ferritin, and Hb concentrations. The method of blood collection was standardized as far as possible... Hb estimations were performed on a ZF Coulter counter... which was calibrated daily...

domain_judgments.rationale: No pre-registered trial protocol is available, one-tailed statistical tests were applied post-hoc or by convention, and multiple subgroup/stratified analyses were conducted.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Because the alternate hypothesis in all comparisons was that the mean of measurements in the fortified group was greater than that in the control group, one-tailed probabilities were reported.

overall_summary: The trial was a well-executed double-blind randomized trial, but risk of bias is rated as some concerns due to substantial loss to follow-up over 2 years (~32%) and the absence of a pre-registered statistical analysis plan along with the use of one-tailed statistical tests.

design_rationale: The study is described as a randomized, double-masked, placebo-controlled trial where eligible women were randomly divided into two groups (iron-fortified vs control).

domain_judgments.rationale: Although the trial states participants were randomly divided and baseline characteristics were comparable between groups, the specific method of sequence generation and allocation concealment was not described.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The anemic women who met the inclusion criteria were randomly divided into 2 groups: the iron-fortified group, who received daily 10 mL of fish sauce fortified with 10 mg Fe, and the control group, who received daily 10 mL of nonfortified fish sauce.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was double-masked with coded bottles, meals were directly supervised by field assistants, and there were no substantial deviations from the intended intervention protocol.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The fish sauce was put into brown glass bottles, coded, and stored in the dark to prevent losses of NaFeEDTA... Field assistants served the meals and monitored meal intake. Compliance was monitored daily.

domain_judgments.rationale: Attrition was relatively low (16 of 152 enrolled, ~10.5%), balanced between groups, and baseline status did not differ between dropouts and completers.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Fifteen women did not complete the study (data at t3 were also missing for 8 of these women) and were not included in the data analysis. Of the 137 women who completed the study, one woman in the control group was excluded from the data analysis because of excessive blood loss (based on estimated body iron)... Initial nutritional status and iron status were not significantly different between the women who dropped out of the study and those who were included in the data analysis.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were objective laboratory biomarkers measured using standardized assays and quality control in a blinded/masked trial.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Hemoglobin was measured in whole blood within 12 h of sampling by using the cyanomethemoglobin method with Sigma diagnostic kits (Sigma, St Louis)... SF and TfR were measured in duplicate at the Division of Hematology, Kansas University Medical Center, Kansas City, and measurements were repeated when the duplicates differed by > 10%.

domain_judgments.rationale: The reported outcomes align with the pre-stated hypotheses, and all primary and secondary iron-status indicators were reported according to standard statistical models.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The principal hypothesis was that the women in the iron-fortified group would have higher hemoglobin concentrations at the end of the study period than would the women in the control group. In addition, we evaluated the influence of iron-fortified fish sauce on laboratory measures of iron status (SF and TfR) and on the prevalence of ID and IDA during the intervention study.

overall_summary: The overall risk of bias is judged to have some concerns due to the lack of details regarding the sequence generation and allocation concealment methods in the randomization process, despite well-controlled double-blind administration and objective outcome measurements.

design_rationale: The study does not describe a random allocation sequence generation method (e.g., random number generator, coin flip), and despite stating students were 'randomly assigned', each treatment condition was actually allocated by school (School 1 = control, School 2 = low-NaFeEDTA, School 3 = high-NaFeEDTA), representing a quasi-experimental non-randomized design.

domain_judgments.rationale: Interventions were allocated at the school level with baseline dietary intake and Hb levels similar across schools, but unmeasured school-level differences or sex ratio imbalances across schools could lead to residual confounding.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The incidence for each school was as follows: school 1, 55 boys and 47 girls in the control group (consuming non-fortified soy sauce); school 2, 39 boys and 63 girls in the low-NaFeEDTA group (consuming NaFeEDTAfortified soy sauce containing 1 mg Fe/mL); school 3, 61 boys and 39 girls in the high-NaFeEDTA group (consuming NaFeEDTA-fortified soy sauce containing 4 mg Fe/mL).

domain_judgments.domain_name: Bias due to selection of participants into the study
domain_judgments.rationale: Participants were selected through screening nearly all available boarding students using pre-defined objective WHO diagnostic criteria for anaemia before intervention assignment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Among the 4022 eligible students in the three selected middle schools, 4008 students were available... Three hundred and four students (155 boys and 149 girls) were diagnosed as anaemic and assigned to one of the three treatment groups.

domain_judgments.rationale: The intervention groups were clearly defined and daily consumption of the fortified/control soy sauce soup was strictly monitored and documented.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: In order to ensure accurate intake, the soup was prepared in the school cafeteria and consumed by the subjects under complete supervision from the teachers. At the same time, detailed information on the soy sauce consumption of each subject was recorded on a consumption sheet.

domain_judgments.domain_name: Bias due to deviations from intended interventions
domain_judgments.rationale: Interventions were delivered under teacher supervision in school cafeterias, ensuring high compliance with no indication of unintended co-interventions.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: In order to ensure accurate intake, the soup was prepared in the school cafeteria and consumed by the subjects under complete supervision from the teachers. At the same time, detailed information on the soy sauce consumption of each subject was recorded on a consumption sheet.

domain_judgments.rationale: Of the 304 anaemic students assigned (102 in School 1, 102 in School 2, 100 in School 3), only 240 were included in the final analyses (~21% attrition across groups), and reasons or handling of missing data were not described.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Three hundred and four students (155 boys and 149 girls) were diagnosed as anaemic and assigned to one of the three treatment groups. The incidence for each school was as follows: school 1, 55 boys and 47 girls in the control group... school 2, 39 boys and 63 girls... school 3, 61 boys and 39 girls... [Table 3 shows Control: 81, Low: 82, High: 77]

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were objective laboratory and biochemical measures assessed using standardized automated assays and commercial kits, unlikely to be influenced by lack of assessor blinding.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Haemoglobin concentration was determined by the cyanomethemoglobin assay. Van-Zij solution was purchased from the Institute of Hematology, Chinese Academy of Preventive Medicine. Quality-control serum samples with a known concentration (127 g/L) were provided by the Shanghai Institute of Clinical Examination. The determination of SI, SF and TF concentrations and TIBC were carried out using the respective assaying kits (Randox, Crumlin, UK), according to the instructions.

domain_judgments.domain_name: Bias in selection of the reported result
domain_judgments.rationale: All planned and expected haematological and biochemical outcomes were fully reported across all time points according to the pre-stated methodology.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Blood haemoglobin (Hb) levels were determined before and after 1 month, 2 months and 3 months of intervention. In addition, serum iron (SI), serum ferritin (SF), free erythrocytic porphyrin (FEP), total iron binding capability (TIBC) and transferritin (TF) were measured before and after consumption of soy sauce for 3 months.

overall_summary: The overall risk of bias is moderate, primarily driven by school-level allocation with potential residual confounding and approximately 21% missing outcome data without detailed reporting on reasons for loss to follow-up.

design_rationale: The study is described as a double-blind intervention with cluster randomization by village into fortified and unfortified fish sauce groups.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although villages were randomly divided into groups, the exact method of sequence generation and allocation concealment was not detailed, raising some concerns.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Villages (n = 21) located in one of 2 communes were randomly divided into 2 groups to receive either unfortified (Group C) or fortified (9 mmol Fe/L as NaFeEDTA, Group F) fish sauce (Type I, 1.07 mol N/L).

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was double-blind with identical packaging of fortified and control fish sauce, and an intention-to-treat analysis adjusting for village clustering was conducted with no notable deviations from intended intervention.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: We evaluated the effectiveness of fortifying fish sauce with NaFeEDTA for improving iron status in women of childbearing age in Vietnam in a double-blind intervention with randomization by village.

domain_judgments.rationale: Loss to follow-up was relatively high at 32.6% across 18 months, and although dropouts were balanced and baseline characteristics did not significantly differ between dropouts and completers, missingness could still plausibly affect the outcome.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A total of 188 women, 99 in Group C and 89 in Group F (32.6% of the whole sample) were lost to follow-up... Multivariate ANOVA was used to compare the baseline characteristics of individuals who were missing data at T18 with those for whom data were available. There was no significant difference (P = 0.14). It was therefore assumed that dropout occurred at random.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were objective biochemical measures (hemoglobin and serum ferritin) analyzed using standard laboratory assays with quality control procedures, blinded to intervention status.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Hemoglobin was determined on whole blood by the cyanomethemoglobin method within 12 h using Sigma diagnostic kits (Sigma)... SF was determined using an ELISA technique (Ramco). Quality control was monitored by analyzing 10% of the samples in duplicate.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial lacked an accessible pre-registered analysis plan, and the planned primary indicator (body iron store calculated using transferrin receptor levels) was dropped due to reported assay problems, leaving some concerns for selective reporting.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Sample size was estimated on the basis of an increase in body iron store as the primary outcome indicator... However, due to technical problems the serum transferrin receptor levels were considered to be unreliable. Therefore, they are not reported.

overall_summary: The overall judgment is some concerns, driven by unclear allocation concealment details during cluster randomization, a moderately high rate of attrition (32.6%) over the 18-month trial, and the omission of the planned primary outcome indicator (transferrin receptor-derived body iron stores) due to technical laboratory issues.
